signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.subtitle: Manage your projects, costs and billing in one place.
signIn.noAccount: Do not have an account yet?

signUp.title: Create your account
signUp.subtitle: A few seconds to start. Then we will tailor ProjectFlow to your business.
signUp.checkEmailBody: We sent a confirmation link to {email}. Open it to finish creating your account.
signUp.emailAlreadyRegistered: An account with this email already exists. Try signing in.
signUp.failed: We could not create the account. Please try again in a moment.

forgotPassword.title: Reset your password
forgotPassword.subtitle: We will email you a link to choose a new password.
forgotPassword.sentBody: If an account exists for {email}, a reset link is on its way.

resetPassword.title: Choose a new password
resetPassword.linkExpired: This reset link is no longer valid. Request a new one.

verifyEmail.title: Email confirmed
verifyEmail.body: Your email is confirmed. You can continue.
verifyEmail.failedBody: This confirmation link is invalid or has expired.

onboarding.title: Set up your business
onboarding.subtitle: We will start ProjectFlow based on your business type. You can change everything later in Settings.
onboarding.recommendedHint: Choose a business type to seed editable defaults. You can change everything later in Settings.
onboarding.countryHint: Sets your default currency and tax rules. You can change it later.
onboarding.presetHint: Sets navigation, suggested capabilities, and display names. You can change everything later. This is not a separate product.
onboarding.workMixHint: Projects, jobs, and service calls share one financial record. This only changes which list stands out. Bill of quantities stays hidden unless you turn it on later.
onboarding.joinExisting: Waiting for an invitation? Ask a colleague to invite your email address.
onboarding.experienceHint: Short questions so navigation, dashboard, and capabilities fit you. You can change everything later in Settings.
onboarding.businessTypeLabel: What kind of business are you?
onboarding.businessTypeHint: Pick the closest profile. You can change it later.
onboarding.workStyleHint: Controls what stands out in navigation. Same financial tracking for everyone.
onboarding.manageHint: Pick what matters. We add these on top of the recommended setup.
onboarding.pathHint: Choose a recommended fit from your answers, or every customer capability.

path.recommendedHint: Shows what fits your business type, including what you chose to manage.
path.allHint: Shows the full ProjectFlow customer capability set. You can hide items later in Settings.
path.noneHint: For power users. No recommendations — configure everything yourself.

setup.title: Sign-in is not configured yet
setup.body: This environment has no sign-in credentials. Ask your administrator to finish setup.
setup.docsHint: Setup details are in your organization’s go-live documentation.
